ACT V OF 1992
ACT
V OF 1992
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act 1989 (XII of 1989).
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 4th June, 1992]
No. Legis.2(14)/92/35, dated
4-6-1992.--The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 31st day of May, 1992 and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on the 2nd day of June, 1992, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of sections 4 and 7 of Act XII of 1989

ACT V OF 1992
ACT
V OF 1992
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act 1989 (XII of 1989).
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 4th June, 1992]
No. Legis.2(14)/92/35, dated
4-6-1992.--The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 31st day of May, 1992 and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on the 2nd day of June, 1992, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab:--
2. Amendment of sections 4 and 7 of Act XII of 1989.-- In the Bank
of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989):--
(a) In section
4, in subsection (1), for the words "two hundred million rupees divided
into twenty million ordinary shares", the words "five hundred
million. rupees divided into fifty million ordinary shares" shall be
substituted; and
(b) In section
7, for the words "sixty per cent.", the words "fifty-one per
cent." shall be substituted.

Repeal
